components.name: Botón Broche Principal (Latch Button)
components.description: Primary pill CTA with an inline SVG latch shackle that rotates open on hover and snaps shut on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #1A2F3B; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.02rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18) inset, 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(26,47,59,0.55); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.35s; } .ds-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn .ds-latch path { transform-origin: 17px 10px; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #265947; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18) inset, 0 16px 26px -12px rgba(26,47,59,0.65); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-latch path { transform: translateY(-2.5px) rotate(18deg); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #D95338; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Botón Fantasma Esmaltado (Ghost Button)
components.description: Secondary pill button with a 2px rolled navy rim that fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #1A2F3B; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.02rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B; transition: background-color 0.25s, color 0.25s, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1A2F3B; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #D95338; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nivel de Portacomidas Clínico (Sage Enamel Tier)
components.description: Enamelled peltre tier container for clinical hospital diets with 360-degree navy rim and tabular temperature badge.
components.html: Alimentación hospitalaria con trazabilidad térmica>65 °C · 5 dietas
components.css: .ds-tier-sage { border-radius: 28px; padding: 28px 32px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #265947 0%, #1B4234 100%); color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B, 0 2px 0 rgba(26,47,59,0.18), 0 18px 34px -16px rgba(26,47,59,0.32); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tier-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-tier-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-tier-fig { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #D95338; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }

components.name: Tarjeta de Selección de Línea (Wizard Choice Tile)
components.description: Tactile radio selection card inside the quote wizard with rolled border and custom radio ring.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: block; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-choice-box { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 18px 18px 18px 48px; border-radius: 18px; background: #EEF2EC; color: #1A2F3B; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(26,47,59,0.18); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.25s, background-color 0.25s; } .ds-choice-box::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18px; top: 22px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-choice input:checked + .ds-choice-box { background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px #265947, 0 10px 20px -12px rgba(26,47,59,0.35); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-choice input:checked + .ds-choice-box::before { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px #265947; } .ds-choice strong { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; } .ds-choice small { color: #3E525D; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Campo de Entrada Institucional (Text Input)
components.description: Form input field with subtle navy border that highlights in clinical sage on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; color: #1A2F3B; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; background: #EEF2EC; color: #1A2F3B; font: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(26,47,59,0.2); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #265947, 0 0 0 4px rgba(38,89,71,0.15); }

components.css: .ds-thermo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28fr 36fr 36fr; min-height: 76px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px; background: #143127; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-zone { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-cold { border-radius: 999px 0 0 999px; background: #C3D8CC; color: #1A2F3B; } .ds-risk { justify-content: center; color: #DAEAE2; border-block: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.28); } .ds-hot { border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; justify-content: flex-end; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F7CE63, #F09B46); color: #1A2F3B; }

narrative.overview:
Catering C.H. Pray S.A.S. sits at the intersection of Colombian home-cooked warmth and hospital-grade institutional rigor ("Cocinamos como en casa. Cumplimos como una institución."). Rather than borrowing the sterile blue-and-white visual language of clinical software or the dark rustic clichés of steakhouse catering, the design system adopts a tangible Colombian material object as its structural spine: the three-tier enamelled peltre lunch carrier (portacomidas).

Every major container on the page behaves like a pressed-steel enamel vessel with a 360-degree rolled rim in deep clinical navy, stacked vertically under a brushed-steel latch handle. Color separates the three operational lines by thermal and culinary nature—clinical sage for hot hospital diets (>65 °C), warm maíz for corporate dining rooms, and cool eucalyptus for vacuum-packed raw proteins (<4 °C)—while tabular operational ledgers and an interactive thermal safety band give hospital procurement and nutrition committees the verifiable data they require.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile enamelled peltre vessels with 360-degree rolled navy rims (inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B) instead of flat wireframe cards or single-sided accent borders.
Thermal and operational color coding across the three tiers: clinical sage (#265947), warm maíz (#F7CE63), and cold-chain eucalyptus (#C3D8CC).
Expressive culinary display typography (Bricolage Grotesque) paired with clinical-grade hyper-legible body copy and tabular figures (Atkinson Hyperlegible).
Mechanical latch-and-tier motion grammar where tiers unstack on hover or scroll and primary buttons physically unclip and latch closed on press.
Scannable clinical ledger rows (Res. 2674/2013, >65 °C / <4 °C, NIT 901.815.422-7) replacing marketing fluff.

rules.name: The Thermal Polarity Rule
rules.body: Dark enamel surfaces (#265947, #1B4234, #1A2F3B) take only white or #F7CE63 text; light enamel surfaces (#F7CE63, #C3D8CC, #EEF2EC, #F7FAF5) take only #1A2F3B or #3E525D text. Never place white text on #F7CE63 or #C3D8CC.

rules.name: The Tomato Punto Rule
rules.body: #D95338 is an instrument indicator, never a surface fill or button background. Use it only on active dots (10px), progress filaments (6px height), and focus/validation marks.

rules.name: The Zero-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings (h2) never carry a small uppercase kicker or pill badge above them. Let the headline and the physical container establish hierarchy directly.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every temperature, gram weight, statutory resolution, and NIT number uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and Bricolage Grotesque bold/extrabold so operational figures anchor the right edge of every row.

rules.name: The Rolled-Rim Rule
rules.body: Borders on enamel vessels are always 360-degree uniform (inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B). Never use single-sided top, left, or bottom accent stripes (border-left: 4px, etc.), which read as generic notification banners.

dos: Do wrap every major content tier and form container in the 360-degree rolled navy rim (inset 0 0 0 2px #1A2F3B) so every surface belongs to the same physical peltre family.
Do use smooth exponential ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) for tier expansions, latch rotations, and step transitions, and honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do label all placeholder food photography transparently with <figcaption>Imagen de referencia</figcaption> until the plant's own documentary photography is substituted.
Do pair every service claim with its concrete operational metric (>65 °C, <4 °C, Res. 2674/2013, NIT 901.815.422-7, 180–250 g).
donts: Don't add uppercase kicker labels, pill badges, or eyebrows above h1 or h2 headings.
Don't use single-sided colored border stripes (border-top or border-left accent bars) on cards or callouts.
Don't nest bordered cards inside .stack-tier panels; use horizontal hairlines and dashed rows (.spec) directly on the enamel surface.
Don't fabricate client logos, hospital names, testimonials, or unverified daily ration counts.
